title: Rotting Orchard
wikitext:
[[File:The Rotting Orchard.jpg|thumb|300px|The Rotting Orchard.]]

'''The Rotting Orchard''' is located in southern [[Duskwood]]—east of the [[Yorgen Farmstead]], west of the [[Tranquil Gardens Cemetery]], and southwest of [[Darkshire]]. It was once a bright fruit orchard loaded with apples, pears, and peaches. Now the orchard lies abandoned, the fruit fallen and rotting in the fields. Recently, the orchard has become home to many ravenous [[worgen]] led by [[Gutspill]] and [[Nefaru]] at nearby [[Roland's Doom]].
